name: label
description: Label text. Defaults to `Search`. Always present in the markup — use `hideLabel` rather than removing it.

name: hideLabel
description: Hides the label visually while keeping it for screen readers.

name: hint
description: Hint text, for example what can be searched.

name: id
description: Input id. Defaults to `search`. Set it when a page has more than one.

name: value
description: Current search term, so it persists on the results page.

name: method
description: Form method. Defaults to `get`, so a search is linkable and shareable.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the form.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the form.
